- New file `crates/nmp-wallet/src/backend/cashu/check_state.rs`: `run_check_state_pass(state)` groups currently-held proofs by canonical mint, calls `MintClient::check_state` once per distinct mint, and for each proof the mint affirmatively reports `Spent`, folds `WalletFact::MintProbed{Spent}` into the ledger and removes it from `state.proofs` via `remove_proofs`. [...] - Only an exact `ProofSpendState::Spent` verdict removes a proof (`filter(state == Spent)`). Pending/Unspent kept. The enum has NO `#[serde(other)]` — an unknown state string is a hard decode error, not a silent 4th state.
- Every failure mode leaves that mint's proofs untouched via `continue`: network/transport error, non-2xx (parse_json_response Errs on status outside 200-299 — proven end-to-end by the 500 test `a_mint_http_failure_never_drops_proofs_for_that_mint`), malformed JSON, response length mismatch, and Y-order mismatch. A garbled/reordered response cannot be misread as spent because parse_check_state_response rejects it before it reaches the pass.
